After several years, the original switch on my Whirlpool dryer failed (dryer would not stop when door opened).  Like other customers, I researched the problem online to find the cause and found a YouTube video on how to replace the switch.  I removed the old switch (#3406104) and searched Amazon to locate a replacement part.  I was able to install the new part in about five minutes.  The replacement piece has three wires instead of the two.  The third wire is for an internal drum light.  My dryer doesn't have a light, so that line doesn't connect to anything inside the wire harness.  The dryer works perfectly now.  I'm very pleased with this part, the great price, and fast shipping.  Thank you!

FYI. I ordered this Dryer Door Switch "blind" (I did NOT open the dryer hood BEFORE I placed the order through Amazon. So when the new switch got here and I popped the hood of my dryer (following a YouTube "How To" video for my Kenmore dryer), I noticed that the switches WERE IDENTICAL, but the Part #'s were off by the last 3~4 digits... I tried it anyway since I got it and it WORKED. As soon as I plugged the 240v plug back into its receptacle the dryer light illuminated! 😉😁
Keep in mind I ordered this particular one over others because of the SLIGHTLY longer wires between the plug and the switch, not to mention the wire "tie" that came pre-installed to keep the wire aaay from the rotation of the drum. Switch worked flawlessly right from the start! 😎

⚠️ ⚠️ Lastly, I would caution you on the plug side and make sure you are careful removing the old switch from the plug because there are two (one on each side of plug) locking teeth that keeps the plug from vibrating loose. Also, depending on the type of plastic the plug is made out of it may be brittle do to the heat of the dryer.

Hope this helps.
